a.xlink:title: Drive a relay ON or OFF.
Drive every relay to the same state, back to back.
IN<n>_ON / IN<n>_OFF: drive, settle, verify, reply.
Dispatch one parsed command (READY state only).
Task body: block on the queue, hand each line to app_fsm_handle_line().
Firmware entry point (called by ESP-IDF after boot).
Drive every relay OFF, even if one of them fails.
ALL_ON / ALL_OFF: drive every relay, settle once, verify all, reply.
Go from INIT to READY, driving all relays OFF first.
